# Toolset `dictionaries`

Public hh.ru dictionaries: areas, industries, roles and more.

**16 tools.** Mutations require an explicit `confirm=true` argument; `Auth` marks tools that need an hh.ru token.

| Tool | Operation | Auth | Confirm | Description |
| --- | --- | :---: | :---: | --- |
| `dict_area` | `GET /areas/{area_id}` | – | – | Get one hh.ru region (area) by its numeric id, including nested children. Optional additional_case=prepositional adds a Russian prepositional-case name. |
| `dict_area_countries` | `GET /areas/countries` | – | – | Get the list of countries known to hh.ru with their numeric ids (each country is also an area). |
| `dict_areas` | `GET /areas` | – | – | Get the full tree of hh.ru regions (areas): countries, federal subjects and cities, with their numeric ids. Optional additional_case=prepositional adds a Russian prepositional-case name. |
| `dict_dictionaries` | `GET /dictionaries` | – | – | Get hh.ru core dictionaries: currencies, genders, vacancies statuses and other enumerations used across the API. |
| `dict_districts` | `GET /districts` | – | – | Get the administrative districts of Russian cities (district ids narrow down a vacancy search within a city). |
| `dict_educational_institutions` | `GET /educational_institutions` | – | – | Get educational institutions by id (up to 50 values per request). Find institution ids with suggest_educational_institutions. |
| `dict_faculties` | `GET /educational_institutions/{id}/faculties` | – | – | Get the faculty list of one educational institution by its id. |
| `dict_industries` | `GET /industries` | – | – | Get the tree of industries (spheres of company activity) with sub-industries and their ids. |
| `dict_languages` | `GET /languages` | – | – | Get the dictionary of foreign languages with their ids. |
| `dict_locales` | `GET /locales` | – | – | Get the locales supported by hh.ru (vacancy interface). |
| `dict_metro` | `GET /metro` | – | – | Get metro lines and stations for all hh.ru cities that have a metro map, grouped by city with station ids. |
| `dict_metro_city` | `GET /metro/{city_id}` | – | – | Get metro lines and stations of a single city by area id (for example 4 = Moscow). |
| `dict_professional_roles` | `GET /professional_roles` | – | – | Get the tree of professional roles (job categories) with sub-categories and their numeric ids; role ids are used in vacancy and resume search. |
| `dict_resume_locales` | `GET /locales/resume` | – | – | Get the locales supported in hh.ru resumes. |
| `dict_skills` | `GET /skills` | – | – | Get key skills by id (one or several; up to 50 values per request). Find skill ids with suggest_skill_set. |
| `dict_vacancy_conditions` | `GET /vacancy_conditions` | – | – | Get the dictionary of paid vacancy placement conditions (branded templates, priority placement and similar options). |
